purpose: Test whether surface-only substrings support unseen combinations; not morphological or semantic inference

generation.disclosure: fixture generator knows latent split; the learner sees only concatenated surface strings with DOCUMENT boundaries

negativeWorld.argument: Given identical training observations, no deterministic learner can distinguish whether missing combinations are licit or forbidden; do not claim semantic validity

notes: No whitespace or token boundary in each observed surface
Each document contains exactly one constructed surface: document boundary is GIVEN, not learned
Train and withheld cells disjoint; all components appear in training
Positive withheld are synthetic, not human semantic gold
Equal-length candidates only when comparing character n-gram whole-form log scores
